metadata.title: Life Simulation Expansion Pack Cover Art

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, multi-layered composition featuring stylized 3D human characters interacting with various domestic animals against a solid blue backdrop with subtle silhouette patterns. The layout is vertically oriented with a large, central typographic stack and a prominent heart-shaped graphic element.
coreVisualRelationships: Characters positioned behind and around the central logo stack to create depth.
Interaction between humans and animals (holding a cat, playing with a dog) establishes the theme.
Contrast between the bright, saturated foreground elements and the muted blue background silhouettes.
A heart-shaped tag hanging from the numerical element as a thematic anchor.
coreInvariants: Solid blue background with faint animal and object silhouettes.
Stylized 3D character models with expressive, joyful facial features.
Centralized vertical hierarchy of text and graphic icons.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Human characters are scaled to fill the upper two-thirds; animals are distributed from the top to the bottom foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large central logo stack and the red heart-shaped tag.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left platform indicator, moves down through the human faces to the central logo, and follows the animals down to the bottom branding.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid blue areas on the left and right sides provide breathing room for secondary silhouettes.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Medium blue background providing a cool, stable base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White and bright green for primary text and icons to ensure legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the heart tag and green for the character's shirt and numerical elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground subjects against a medium-value, lower-saturation background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses thick, rounded slab-serifs with heavy blue drop shadows.
Numerical elements use a blocky, italicized sans-serif with a green-to-light-green gradient.
Secondary text uses a clean, wide-set geometric sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the primary title are slightly staggered and overlapping.
The 'Pets' text is placed inside a red heart with a white dashed border to mimic a pet tag.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, playful display face paired with a wide, technical geometric sans-serif for informational clarity.

preserve: Blue drop shadows on main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric weight and clarity of the secondary text.
Provides a similar rounded, heavy slab-serif feel for the main title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3D render of a smiling man in a green shirt and a woman in a red sweater, surrounded by a golden retriever, a beagle, and two cats. Set them against a solid medium-blue background featuring faint silhouettes of a birdcage and animal shapes. Leave the center-middle area clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large white slab-serif title with thick blue outlines and shadows in the center. Below it, place a large green '2' with a gradient. Hang a red heart-shaped tag with a white dashed border from the '2', containing white rounded text. Add a wide-spaced white sans-serif subtitle at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the heart tag visually connected to the number?
Are the background silhouettes subtle enough not to distract?
Does the main title have a clear 3D depth effect?
Is the character interaction warm and domestic?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is cut off by the edges.
Verify the '2' has a distinct green gradient.
Check that characters appear to be looking at or interacting with the pets.
Confirm the blue drop shadow on the main title is consistent.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine 3D character group + domestic animals + solid blue background with silhouettes + centered vertical typographic stack + heart-shaped icon.
